verified.title: India beat Pakistan by 19 runs to retain Asian Games men’s cricket gold
verified.body: India defended its Asian Games T20 cricket title, beating Pakistan in the men’s final in Nagoya.

verified.title: Brazil beat India 4-0 in Kolkata friendly
verified.body: Brazil defeated India 4-0 in an international friendly in Kolkata, with Samuel Lino scoring twice.

verified.title: India-Pakistan summon each other’s top envoys after Punjab border incident
verified.body: India and Pakistan summoned each other’s diplomatic representatives after the BSF said it had killed two suspected infiltrators in Punjab; both sides issued competing accounts.

verified.title: Delhi protests over voter-roll changes continue for a second day
verified.body: Police detained several people during protests in New Delhi over recent voter-roll changes. The Election Commission has defended the revision exercise.

verified.title: India weighs lower pulse import duties to contain food prices
verified.body: Reuters reported that India is considering reducing import tariffs on some pulses to improve supply and help curb food inflation.

verified.title: Indian shares record an eighth straight weekly fall
verified.body: Indian benchmark indexes posted their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years, according to Reuters, amid foreign outflows and pressure from oil and global yields.

verified.title: Rajasthan Congress to probe cross-voting in local body polls
verified.body: The Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee formed a nine-member panel led by former Assembly Speaker C.P. Joshi to examine alleged cross-voting and related complaints.

verified.title: Captive-bred Great Indian Bustards set for first release into the wild
verified.body: Two captive-bred male Great Indian Bustard chicks are expected to be released in existing enclosures in Desert National Park, Jaisalmer.

verified.title: Gujarat UCC Bill receives President’s assent
verified.body: The Gujarat Uniform Civil Code Bill 2026 received President Droupadi Murmu’s assent; the state government will determine its implementation date.

verified.title: West Bengal tops Viksit Bharat youth quiz participation target
verified.body: The state recorded more than 311,000 participants in the Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue 2027 quiz, according to Times of India.

verified.title: IMD forecasts rain across several states; wet spell likely in south and northeast
verified.body: The India Meteorological Department forecast rainfall in multiple regions, including Kerala, Karnataka, parts of northeast India, Odisha, West Bengal and Maharashtra.

verified.title: Russia says it will continue strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities
verified.body: Russia said it would continue targeted retaliatory strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities as fighting continues.

verified.title: Ethiopian federal forces retake airport in Tigray capital, sources say
verified.body: Federal forces recaptured Alula Aba Nega Airport in Mekelle amid renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia. The situation remains volatile.

verified.title: US Supreme Court begins new term with major constitutional disputes ahead
verified.body: The new Supreme Court term is set to address major disputes involving gun rights, religion in public schools and voting restrictions.

verified.title: Chinese construction work on Antelope Reef accelerates, satellite images show
verified.body: Reuters reported that work on a runway at Antelope Reef in the disputed Paracel Islands is progressing, according to analysis of satellite imagery.

verified.title: Asian Games organisers face scrutiny over operational problems
verified.body: Japan’s Olympic chief said organisers of the Asian Games need to reflect on preparations after transport and other operational problems.

verified.title: UK government drops plans to curb jury trials after backlash
verified.body: The government abandoned controversial proposals to limit jury trials in less serious criminal cases following criticism from legal professionals and politicians.

verified.title: Iranian rial hits new low as central bank moves to support currency
verified.body: Iran’s central bank announced an injection of up to $2 billion as the rial continued to weaken amid sanctions and regional tensions.

verified.title: Lula holds lead in polls ahead of Brazil’s first-round vote
verified.body: A series of polls showed President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva slightly ahead of Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, with a runoff still likely.

developing.title: Punjab border incident draws competing claims from India and Pakistan
developing.body: The two governments have issued different accounts of the incident and diplomatic protests have followed. Further official statements may change the picture.

developing.title: Fighting intensifies around Mekelle in Ethiopia’s Tigray region
developing.body: Federal forces say they have retaken the airport while reports indicate continuing clashes and instability around the city.

developing.title: Russia-Ukraine strikes remain active as Kyiv signals further action against Russian refineries
developing.body: Ukraine said it would continue targeting Russian refineries in response to Moscow’s airstrike policy; the situation remains fluid.
